EmailTemplate.subject: We missed you at our “Healthy Bites: Modernizing Payments to Empower the New Healthcare Consumer” webinar!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
We missed you! Our “Healthy Bites: Modernizing Payments to Empower the New Healthcare Consumer” webinar included an in depth discussion around how revenue cycle leaders can address rising consumer demand and enable a new healthcare consumer experience.
Our panelists featured:
- Kelle Humphries, Owner & Founder of Adamas Healthcare Consulting
- Amy Carpenter, VP of Strategic Accounts, Healthcare at Flywire
Here is the link to the webinar recording <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/healthy-bites-recording-modernizing-payments-to-empower-the-new-healthcare-consumer]]>.
Have questions? If you are a Flywire client, please reach out to your Client Success Manager. If not, just reply to this email and we’ll connect you with someone who can help.
Have a great day! Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States
